title: Enhancing LLMs with Cognitive-Affective Personality Inference for Simulating Human Social-Psychological Behavior
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate human participants in social and behavioral studies, yet static persona prompting typically maps a participant profile and an experimental scenario directly to a response, entangling stable dispositions with situation-specific interpretations. To address this limitation, we introduce \textbf{SPIN}, a cognitive-affective personality system-inspired inference pipeline for simulating human social-psychological behavior. Specifically, SPIN implements this structured inference process through three zero-shot LLM calls that compile a task-blind participant core, elicit condition-specific cognitive-affective states, and read out decisions from those states, thereby reusing stable personality structure while routing each trial-specific response through an explicit state representation. We evaluate SPIN on two reconstructed social-psychological study families spanning uncertainty reasoning and pluralistic ignorance, across four base LLMs. Compared with blank, demographic, narrative, and chain-of-thought prompt variants, SPIN consistently delivers the strongest overall alignment performance across base LLMs and study families. Ablations and state analyses further show that both personality compilation and structured state elicitation contribute to the gains, and that the elicited states shift interpretably across informational and normative conditions. These results suggest that structured personality-state inference can improve benchmark-level behavioral alignment beyond richer persona descriptions or generic multi-step reasoning.

brief: 洞见：SPIN通过将LLM推理分解为任务盲人格编译、情境特定状态引发和状态锚定决策三个阶段，解决了静态persona prompting将稳定人格与情境解释纠缠的问题，使模型能同时保持行为稳定性和条件敏感性。
方法：基于CAPS认知-情感人格系统理论，设计三阶段零样本推理管道，使用结构化JSON schema约束人格特质向量（5维）和瞬时状态变量（6维），通过阶段间输入限制防止信息泄露，并遵循因果排序反映人类决策的时间逻辑。
用途：可尝试将人格-状态分解机制迁移用于个体历史状态更新建模，在博弈场景中捕捉参与者稳定偏好与动态情境评估的交互，适用于多轮交互中的行为模拟。
限制：SPIN是结构化推理接口而非验证过的心理测量工具，其优势部分可能来自额外的推理调用和格式控制；评估仅限两个研究家族和四个基座LLM，泛化性待验证。

sections.研究问题: 论文研究如何增强LLM以模拟人类社会心理行为中的个体决策。核心问题：现有静态persona prompting将参与者profile和实验场景直接映射到响应，将稳定人格特质与情境特异性解释纠缠在同一生成步骤中，导致跨试次参与者一致性差、对条件变化的敏感性不足[s2]。研究目标是将模拟质量操作化为基准级行为对齐——即让LLM模拟响应与理论相关的人类行为摘要（选择率、评分统计等）匹配[s6]。
sections.核心 insight: 论文提出核心发现：个体行为的同时稳定性和可变性可以通过CAPS认知-情感人格系统来解释和建模。SPIN的关键洞见是将人格模拟分解为两个层次：稳定人格核心（跨试次复用）和条件敏感状态（按需重新计算），两者通过结构化接口连接而非端到端生成[s21][s22]。消融实验验证了状态引发层具有功能性后果——移除状态引出会使模型决策趋于高响应策略，在已知竞争条件下防御性上升、在已知合作条件下信任上升，状态变量跨条件系统性重组[s138][s141]。此外，结构化schema比自由形式中间推理更有效，说明约束语义比灵活性更重要[s57]。
sections.方法机制: SPIN实现为三阶段零样本推理管道[s23]：第一阶段Compile从参与者profile提取结构化人格核心，包含5维特质向量（公平敏感度、规范敏感度、互惠取向、不确定性厌恶、自我保护倾向）和规则集及决策风格摘要[s26][s27][s28]，该阶段仅接收profile、任务盲目、不看试次信息[s38]。第二阶段Elicit将人格核心与当前试次刺激映射到瞬时认知-情感状态，输出6维状态变量（唤醒度、冲突、社会关注、信任、感知被利用风险、自我保护驱动）及决策模式和理由[s30][s31][s32]，该阶段只看人格核心和试次，不重新读取原始profile[s38]。第三阶段Decide基于引发状态生成行为响应、置信度和标准答案[s34][s35][s36]。管道遵循因果排序：人格先于情境、情境激活状态、状态驱动决策[s39]。
sections.实验与结果: 论文在Shafir-Tversky不确定性推理家族和Prentice-Miller多元无知家族上测试[s7][s42]，对比四个基座LLM。结果：SPIN在所有四个基座上均取得最高平均对齐分数，在两个研究家族上均排名第一[s51]，对比Blank/Demographic/Narrative/CoT基线均显著优于[s135]。消融实验：移除人格编译或状态引出均降低性能，状态引出贡献更大（0.036-0.055 vs 0.021-0.033降幅）[s56]。自由形式中间推理大幅下降，验证结构化schema的重要性[s57]。状态分析：已知竞争抑制信任并增加感知被利用风险和自我保护，已知合作则相反[s141]。
sections.局限: 论文明确指出：1) SPIN是结构化推理接口而非验证过的心理测量工具，其特质和状态变量由基础LLM在手工设计schema下生成，不等于独立心理测量验证[s207]；2) 部分优势可能来自额外推理调用和格式控制，而非仅CAPS启发的schema[s208]；3) 评估仅限两个研究家族和四个基座LLM，泛化性待验证[s208]；4) 不保证忠实个体级模拟或人类认知机制的因果恢复[s207]；5) t检验效力有限（仅4个配对单元）[s134]。
sections.与研究的联系: 论文直接服务于研究档案中个体行为和人格一致性建模的核心方向。通过引入人格-状态分解机制，SPIN能够模拟人类社会心理行为中的个体差异、跨试次一致性和条件敏感性。两个研究家族分别覆盖不确定性推理（个体决策）和多元无知（社会规范误解），验证了机制在个体层面（人格特质驱动决策）和群体层面（私人态度与感知规范的系统性偏差）的有效性[s88][s89][s90]。
sections.可借鉴方式: 1) 人格-状态分解机制可尝试迁移用于个体历史状态更新建模，将稳定人格核心类比为智能体的持久偏好，将情境状态类比为当前上下文激活的临时状态；2) 状态引出的消融验证方法可用于研究中间表示的行为因果性[s56]；3) 多维度评测指标体系（均值校准、差距结构、离散度、对序关系）可借鉴用于评估模拟行为与实验真值的对齐质量[s44][s45][s46]；4) 迁移条件：需有结构化的参与者profile和任务信息，且目标任务涉及稳定偏好与情境敏感反应的交互，而非纯知识检索任务。

title: Wiki-Talkie: Multilingual Benchmarking of Persona-Based Agents on Real-World Discussions
summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in social environments, making it critical to study their ability to faithfully simulate human interactions. Central to this is grounding agents in realistic user personas, yet existing datasets rely on fictional personas and are limited to a handful of languages, lacking the empirical grounding necessary to evaluate behavioral fidelity across diverse populations. We introduce Wiki-Talkie, a multilingual dataset of real-world conversations from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages spanning two language families: Germanic (German, English) and Romance (Spanish, French, Italian), paired with personas derived from real user communities and encompassing sociodemographic attributes, self-descriptions, and behaviorally grounded interaction traits. Using Wiki-Talkie, we evaluate agent interactional behavior on a next-turn generation task across various persona conditioning strategies. Our evaluation assesses whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions. Results show that user's comment history exemplifying interaction behavior consistently outperforms explicit persona information. In addition, models systematically underproduce negative or extreme sentiments, while over producing references and suggestions, revealing biases toward agreeableness and positivity. Crucially, these patterns hold robustly across languages, with small cross-lingual differences.

sections.研究问题: Wiki-Talkie评估基于人格的LLM智能体在真实Wikipedia讨论页中生成下一轮评论的能力，关注人群层面行为分布忠实度(population fidelity)而非个体人格一致性[s7]。研究涵盖五种语言(德、英、西、法、意)，对应individual方向的个体人格模拟与行为一致性评测需求，以及interaction方向的人际交互行为评估。核心任务是next-turn generation：给定线程前序评论，智能体扮演特定用户角色生成回复[s24]。
sections.核心 insight: 论文提出三个核心发现：(1) 具体行为演示——通过评论历史(history)或配合推理的行为特质(behavior+r)——比抽象描述(profile)和人口统计信息更有效[s37]；(2) 信息类型(type)而非信息数量驱动性能差异，增加profile token预算不能改善模拟效果[s118]；(3) 智能体系统性过度生成Request和Commit行为，产出更少Negative情感和Report行为，呈现亲善性与积极性偏差[s44]。
sections.方法机制: 数据集从Wikipedia Talk页提取五种语言的真实讨论线程，配对用户人格(自述档案+行为特质)；设计了五种条件化方法(base、profile、behavior、behavior+r、history)输入LLM生成回复[s26]。评估采用多层次指标：文本相似度(BERTScore、ROUGE-L)评估个体层面，对话行为分布(JS散度)和情感分布(Wasserstein距离)评估群体层面[s30]。对话行为类别包括CRIT、NEG、POS、PART、INF、REP、COM、REQ、ASK、REF十类。
sections.实验与结果: History条件化在所有语言中获得最高文本相似度(ROUGE-L最高0.154，Model A西班牙语)，行为密度比在history方法下升至0.7以上帮助接近人类水平[s35, s109]。对话行为JSD分数在0.1-0.3之间，表明中等程度分歧[s40]。情感对齐趋势与对话行为一致：history方法情感WD最低(0.097，Model C英语)[s46]。Agent生成的评论普遍比人类更长(人类48-78词，Agent可能超过200词)，但history方法使Model A的评论长度降至约88词[s108]。

title: Learning to Simulate Individuals from Macro Social Signals
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate how individuals respond to new situations, yet the behavioral reasoning behind these responses is either inherited from pretraining or learned from individual-level annotations, which offer limited behavioral diversity and little supervision of the reasoning itself. We propose to learn behavioral reasoning from prediction markets, whose price trajectories record how populations respond to real-world events at scale. We introduce macro2mind, which trains a language model with GRPO using market signals. A social behavioral decomposition makes behavioral reasoning an explicit step of forecasting: the model infers representative groups of market participants, predicts how each interprets the news and updates its beliefs, reasons about their interactions, and aggregates these responses into a price. A hindsight-regret curriculum with difficulty-aware sampling focuses training on transitions where hindsight-identified groups substantially improve the forecast while prioritizing examples that remain learnable for the current policy. The learned reasoning applies to user simulation without further training. On SWM-Bench, macro2mind achieves state-of-the-art directional accuracy and correlation on Polymarket. Trained on market data, it transfers zero-shot to four user-simulation benchmarks (Humanual, OvertonBench, PRISM, and CAD) and has competitive performance among zero-shot methods. Used as a data generator, macro2mind also raises a downstream simulator's accuracy on unseen users by 15.5 points, outperforming data generated by its backbone by 13.2 points.

sections.核心 insight: 市场价格是分散信念的聚合，每笔价格波动都隐式记录了异质性个体解释新闻、适应同伴并聚合为新价格的微观过程[s7]。通过将行为推理显式结构化为社会行为分解（群体初始化→一阶响应→二阶聚合），模型学习到可迁移的行为过渡函数，既能预测市场走势也能模拟个体响应[s28][s29][s30][s31]。hindsight-regret curriculum通过计算知道关键参与者后预测差距来筛选真正需要推理的过渡，是迁移成功的关键驱动因素[s67][s38]。
sections.方法机制: 社会行为分解将行为推理建模为单次自回归轨迹，包含三个阶段：(1)τprop推断可能驱动市场变化的代表性参与者群体并构建先验状态[s29]；(2)τF预测每个参与者基于自身先验和观察的信念更新和一阶响应[s30]；(3)τA建模参与者间的交互如何相互影响信念和行动，最后聚合为价格[s31]。两个任务共享行为过渡函数，将先验状态和上下文映射到信念更新和可观察结果[s32]。训练采用hindsight-regret curriculum计算Δ=E[R~(y^H)]-E[R~(y)]并结合难度感知采样[s35][s38]。个体模拟时将用户作为单一参与者，已有人格作为先验状态[s154]。

title: Disentangling Models from Personas in Heterogeneous LLM Simulations
comment: Presented as a Spotlight Paper at the Second Workshop on Social Simulation with LLMS, Third Conference on Language Modeling, 2026
summary: Multi-agent simulations with large language models (LLMs) often operate networks of agents with a single base model. This overlooks the inter-model effects which may dominate engagement dynamics in real-world deployments. To show this, we simulate a heterogeneous social network powered by several different base models and show that the amount of engagement an agent receives depends more on its base model than on its assigned persona. The attraction or repulsion effects of a base model strengthen dramatically when more models are added in the mix, suggesting that networks dynamics may converge to base model effects at scale. To help explain this effect, we conduct a series of content-mediating analyses, showing the predictability of base models across contexts as well as the relationship between a model's lexical patterns and an engagement-maximizing style. In light of recent developments in mass multi-agent interaction, this work underscores the relevance of heterogeneous compositions in driving the outcomes of those networks

title: Thin Evidence, Thick Priors: How Language Models Substitute Identity for Missing Financial Facts
comment: 49 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables; Submitted & Accepted to ICAIF'2026
summary: People increasingly ask large language models what to do with their money, yet seldom describe their finances in full. This paper asks what a model does with the gap. Holding finances fixed and changing only who the investor is said to be, we grade the financial evidence in the prompt from eight facts to none and measure how far the recommended equity allocation moves. Across 96,600 prompts to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, built from 100 financial profiles, 138 personas and seven disclosure conditions, the average gap between two personas with identical finances rises from 4.78 percentage points at full disclosure to 10.34 points with no financial facts. A two-way cluster bootstrap counting duplicated prompts once places the ratio at 2.16 (95% interval 1.69 to 2.79), and the rise is already 1.69-fold with a single fact left. Identity explains 5% of within-profile variation in advice at full disclosure and 96% with no disclosure. Household size is the only attribute whose influence grows reliably as evidence is withdrawn. Once standard errors are clustered on the persona, the unit to which identity was assigned, most attribute-specific interactions reported in the conference version lose significance, and gender instead appears as a small standing gap that full disclosure does not close. Stating risk appetite alone brings the swing into the range seen with two to seven generic facts. With no facts, the model's one-line rationale cites incomes, debts and savings it was never told, and these invented finances turn adverse more often for larger households. Inside the network, gender is linearly decodable at every layer, and ablating the gender direction at five layers leaves the aggregate identity swing unchanged. Advisory systems built on such models should be audited at the disclosure levels users actually reach, and judged across the whole identity space rather than one attribute at a time.

用途：可迁移用于审计AI对话系统在人机交互中如何依赖用户隐含的人口学属性，检测信息缺失时的身份偏见填充机制。

sections.方法机制: 采用"证据刻度盘"设计：同一投资者画像在6个嵌套披露水平（L0:8个财务变量全披露到L5:无财务事实）下呈现，每次提示变更人物角色而非财务信息[s9]。96,600次提示实验覆盖100个财务档案×138个人物角色×7种披露条件。使用两层聚类bootstrap（以人物为聚类单位）处理标准误估计，避免因同一人物重复出现导致的假显著[s85]。机制分析包括：探测实验（gender在每层可线性解码）[s16]、补丁实验（跨人物迁移属性）和转向实验（消融性别方向后观察身份总摆动是否减少）[s117]。

title: Simulating Strategies for Defense Against Brand-Targeted Online Disinformation
summary: Brand-targeted disinformation can damage firms not only by spreading false beliefs, but by eroding trust, amplifying reputational uncertainty, and persisting across networked digital environments. This paper models brand-targeted disinformation as a trust-weighted contagion process using a multi-agent simulation across six network structures, three amplification levels, and six intervention strategies. Results show that scale-free and influencer-heavy networks are most vulnerable to rapid spread, while clustered and polarized networks provide partial containment until amplification bridges communities. Hybrid intervention combining prebunking, trusted-node activation, and rapid correction performs best overall. The paper contributes a reusable simulation framework for studying active brand disinformation defense strategies.

brief: 洞见：品牌虚假信息通过信任加权传染过程在网络中扩散，信任既是传播结果也是传播机制，企业虽是信息源但非信任源。
方法：多智能体离散时间模拟，信任加权传染模型，含异质性代理行为参数（易感性、信源可信度敏感性、分享阈值）和六种网络结构。
用途：信任加权扩散模型可用于模拟群体内观点如何通过信任关系传播；网络结构脆弱性分析可类比研究群体共识形成的网络条件；干预组合框架可评测群体行为纠正策略。
限制：使用合成网络和简化假设，结果应解读为方向性；虚假声明为静态未考虑叙事变异；放大效应用可见性参数简化未模拟推荐系统。

sections.研究问题: 论文研究品牌目标虚假信息在网络中的传播机制与防御干预策略，直接服务于社会网络信息传播建模[p3]。核心研究问题包括：网络结构如何影响传播范围与速度（RQ1）、不同干预策略的有效性比较（RQ2）、放大效应何时增强或削弱干预效果（RQ3）、各策略的适用条件（RQ4）。研究目标不是预测特定真实事件，而是识别不同干预策略在何种条件下更有效[p2]。
sections.核心 insight: 论文提出品牌虚假信息是信任加权传染过程，信任是连接信息采纳与纠正的核心机制[p8]。企业虽是信息发布源但并非信任来源，信任节点的背书对信息可信度影响更大。混合干预策略（prebunking+信任节点激活+快速纠正）综合效果最优，峰值感染率0.242、恢复率0.999、重感染率0.061[p6]。无标度网络和影响者主导网络最脆弱（峰值0.965和0.947），聚类和极化网络因社区边界提供部分遏制[p7]。放大效应在聚类网络中增幅最大（0.546→0.827），因帮助突破社区边界[p7]。
sections.方法机制: 离散时间多智能体模拟框架，包含六类异质性代理（消费者、怀疑者、品牌倡导者、敌对行动者、影响者、制度验证者）和五种状态转移（易感→暴露→相信→纠正/恢复→抗性/免疫）[p4]。核心参数包括品牌信任基线、信源可信度敏感性、易感性、强化敏感性、分享阈值、信任衰减与恢复[p4]。传播分三路径：暴露→采纳→分享，采纳决策受易感性、先前态度、信源可信度敏感性和社会强化共同决定[p4]。实验设计：六种网络结构（随机、无标度、小世界、聚类社区、极化模块化、影响者主导）×三种放大水平×六种干预策略，共540次运行[p6]。
sections.实验与结果: 评测指标分三类：扩散指标（峰值感染率、总暴露、总分享、达峰时间）、恢复指标（恢复率、纠正参与）、持久性指标（重感染率、品牌信任恢复）[p6]。无干预基线峰值感染率0.823，预揭发仅降至0.789效果有限[p7]。无标度和影响者主导网络最脆弱，聚类和极化网络因社区边界降低扩散但放大可桥接社区[p7]。混合干预在几乎所有网络结构和放大水平下表现最优[p8]。预揭发适合预防，快速纠正在放大环境中效果下降，信任节点激活适合减少持续性[p9]。
sections.局限: 论文明确指出使用合成网络和适度规模模拟，结果应解读为方向性而非确定性结论[p6]。信任建模简化，未捕捉信任动态的复杂性[p6]。企业作为低信任信源的机制需要进一步验证[p6]。虚假声明设为静态，未考虑叙事变异和真实世界复杂性[p6]。放大效应用简化的可见性参数，未模拟真实推荐系统机制[p6]。
sections.与研究的联系: 直接服务于社会/群体研究方向的信息传播与观点演化模拟[p3]。信任网络结构和信源可信度敏感性机制可迁移用于群体决策中意见传播研究。干预策略机制（prebunking、信任节点激活时机）可用于研究集体行为纠正。模拟框架提供可复用的社会传播研究方法论[p2]。
sections.可借鉴方式: 信任加权扩散模型架构可用于模拟群体内观点如何通过信任关系传播，可尝试迁移至群体决策场景[p3]。网络结构脆弱性分析可类比用于研究特定网络拓扑对群体共识形成的影响，不同网络类型的传播差异可作为群体网络设计的参考[p7]。干预时机与策略组合的实验框架可移植用于评测不同信息干预对群体行为的效果，混合策略优于单一策略的发现对群体干预设计有启示[p8]。多指标评测体系（扩散、恢复、持久性）可用于群体行为研究的评估设计[p6]。

title: Independent Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual Semantic-Social World Models
summary: Fully decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), also referred to as independent learning, requires each agent to learn and act using only its local information and experience, without a centralized critic or inter-agent communication. Such a stringent information structure renders the conventional reward signal ambiguous. A poor return may result from an ineffective ego action, an incompatible teammate response, or an effective opponent response, yet scalar rewards alone do not reveal which explanation is responsible. We argue that agents can learn more effectively by prospectively comparing the consequences of candidate actions rather than diagnosing failures only from realized returns. We introduce CASTLE (Counterfactual Action-conditioned Semantic Tokens for Local Execution in Decentralized MARL), an offline-training, online-in-context guidance framework with two complementary world models. A Local Dynamics World Model, offline pre-trained over agents' local trajectories, summarizes the agent's local trajectory dynamics and partial observability, while a Semantic-Social World Model predicts compact short-horizon task and social consequences for each candidate ego action. The latter is trained from counterfactual simulator rollouts that expose plausible teammate and opponent responses to alternative actions taken from the same logged rollout state. During online learning and execution, both world models remain frozen and are queried by agents using only locally available information. Their prediction logits provide in-context guidance to an independent PPO policy. Across 30 matched seeds on Tag, Spread, and Adversary in the benchmark multi-particle environments, our proposed CASTLE achieves the highest mean final score among the evaluated methods, exceeding the strongest baseline on each task by 10.67, 6.46, and 0.33 normalized points, respectively.

title: Who Is Talking to the Agent? LLMs in Multi-User 3D Virtual Environments
summary: When several people share a 3D virtual room with an LLM agent, the agent must decide not only what to say, but whether an utterance was addressed to it and, if accessible, what profile information about the others present it may use. To study both problems, we construct LookAway, a controlled corpus of 40 sessions involving 80 distinct personas and an LLM agent (1,200 turns), including ambiguous-addressee turns in which speaker orientation agrees or conflicts with the intended addressee. Across three open-weight large language models and five conditions varying which profiles the agent sees and whether it is told where each person faces (18,000 decisions), adding speaker orientation increased addressee accuracy from 56% to 99.5% when orientation was congruent, but when the speaker faced someone other than the addressee, two of the models went by where the speaker faced on more than 85% of those turns. Warning one model that orientation could be misleading reduced this only modestly. A browser-based 3D demonstrator shows the effect live: the same sentence gets an answer when the speaker faces the agent and silence when they face the other person. Providing both personas' profiles improved responses about the person being asked about, but also increased the use of profile attributes not revealed in the shared conversation, reaching 45.3% of answers for one model. More context thus improves multi-user interaction but also leads to oversharing, so shared LLM agents need mechanisms for weighing spatial cues and controlling when user-specific information enters a response.

title: When to Remember, When to Abstain: Category-Conditioned Retention for Reliable Agent Memory
comment: 4 pages, 1 Figure, Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Social Agent Workshop (https://openreview.net/group?id=NeurIPS.cc%2F2026%2FWorkshop%2FSocialAgent#tab-your-consoles)
summary: Persistent agent memory is only as reliable as its retention decision: an assertion weakly supported by its source can be stored and later reused as established fact. We study whether the retention decision should be governed by a confidence bar conditioned on the semantic category of the assertion rather than by a single global threshold, retaining well-evidenced categories liberally while abstaining more aggressively where inference is unreliable. We evaluate this in a deployed cold-start memory pipeline on 100 synthetic personas. The empirical evaluation is motivated by a sharp reliability asymmetry: across 4{,}715 candidate assertions, only 77.9\% of value and belief assertions are supported by their source, versus 96.2\% for all other categories. A global confidence threshold cannot separate these: it either admits unsupported value claims or discards well-evidenced ones. Conditioning the threshold on category resolves the tradeoff. In repeated held-out evaluation, a stricter bar on values alone reduces unsupported retentions from 6.2\% to 4.0\% (an ${\approx}36\%$ relative reduction, modest but consistent across folds) and, as corroborating evidence, preserves an estimated 13 percentage points more coverage (95\% CI 9.8--16.0) than a global threshold at comparable retention. Our results suggest that reliable retention depends on the type of assertion, not on confidence alone, and that a category-conditioned threshold can act as a simple, effective form of selective prediction at the write boundary.

sections.研究问题: 论文研究智能体记忆系统中写入边界（write boundary）的可靠性决策问题[s4]。核心问题是：当从用户内容中提取候选断言时，应根据什么标准决定是否将其写入长期记忆。具体聚焦于：不同语义类别的断言是否具有不同的可靠性特征，全局置信度阈值是否次优，以及如何通过类别条件阈值改善记忆可靠性[s5][s6]。这与个体研究方向相关，因为记忆系统处理的是关于用户价值、信念和偏好的信息提取与保留决策。
sections.核心 insight: 论文发现语义类别间的可靠性存在显著非对称性：价值和信念类别的断言仅有77.9%被源内容支持，而其他类别高达96.2%[s2][s5]。这种不对称性使得全局阈值陷入两难：若阈值宽松则接受不可靠的价值声明，若阈值严格则丢弃其他类别中有可靠支持的内容。类别条件阈值通过针对性地对低可靠性类别设置更严格标准来化解这一矛盾[s13][s18]。实验证明，针对values类别设置更严格阈值可在保持相当保留率的同时，将不可靠断言从6.2%降至4.0%，同时覆盖率比全局阈值高约13个百分点[s20][s22]。需要注意的是，该发现是在特定提取器和合成数据上验证的，类别可靠性排序本身是否可跨场景迁移未被系统验证[s6][s25]。
sections.方法机制: 论文将记忆写入决策建模为选择性预测（selective prediction）问题[s6]。系统使用已部署的冷启动记忆管道，每个语义类别有独立的提取器，输出候选断言、置信度分数和类别标签。策略包括：不过滤（写入所有）、全局阈值（所有类别统一阈值）、类别条件阈值（不同类别可有不同阈值）[s11][s12]。论文明确指出类别条件阈值有效的两个条件：不可靠断言集中在单一类别，且该类别内置信度能区分支持与不支持的断言[s13]。阈值通过五折交叉验证拟合（按人格分割），优化faithfulness指标同时约束保留率不低于80%[s15]。研究采用最小化实现，仅对预指定的values类别设置差异化阈值，测试一个明确假设而非在全量数据上搜索最优类别[s13]。
sections.实验与结果: 实验使用100个合成人格产生的4715个候选断言[s15]。主要指标包括：faithfulness（保留断言中获得源支持的比例）、coverage（对显著源事实的召回）、retention（保留率）[s29][s31]。结果：write-all基线faithfulness为92.24%，全局阈值达到93.83%（coverage降至70.30%），类别条件阈值达到96.03%（coverage保持83.26%）[s22]。类别条件阈值相比全局阈值，faithfulness提升2.21个百分点，coverage提升12.96个百分点，且在所有100个交叉验证折上coverage差异方向一致[s20]。价值观类别内部，置信度从最低到最高bin，支持率从约59%升至约90%[s18]。
sections.局限: 论文明确指出三个主要局限[s25]：第一，faithfulness和coverage由LLM judge评分而非人类标注，绝对数值与judge相关，但类别排序跨judge稳定；第二，评估仅在合成人格数据上完成，真实用户数据的可靠性分布尚未验证；第三，研究采用最小化实现（单一预指定类别），对整个类别施加相同阈值可能过于粗糙。附录显示judge重评分时4.71%的断言判定翻转[s45]，跨模型比较中GPT-5在values类别上支持率仅62.4%而Gemini达84.0%[s47]，说明judge依赖问题确实存在，且不同模型在低可靠性类别上的表现差异更大，这意味着在真实用户场景下迁移该机制时需重新校准。
sections.与研究的联系: 论文属于技术系统研究，直接研究对象是智能体记忆管道的可靠性设计，而非个体行为建模[s4]。但其处理的内容——用户价值、信念、偏好等个体属性信息的提取与可靠性评估——与个体研究方向存在间接联系。论文的方法论暗示：个体生成内容中不同类型的声明可能具有不同的推断可靠性，特别是价值观类声明需要更严格的证据标准。然而论文未研究社会交互、群体行为或个体间关系，与interaction、group、society方向无直接关联。
sections.可借鉴方式: 可尝试将类别条件阈值的思想迁移用于个体行为研究，但需明确这是验证性迁移而非已证实的应用。具体步骤：1）在目标数据集上评估不同语义类别的推断可靠性分布，识别是否存在类似的不对称性[s18]；2）验证低可靠性类别内置信度是否能区分支持与不支持的断言，若条件满足则对该类别设置更严格阈值[s13]；3）阈值设置可参考论文的交叉验证方法，复用提取器已有的置信度和类别信号[s15]。需要强调的限制：论文验证仅在合成人格数据上完成[s25]，真实用户场景下类别可靠性模式可能不同；论文使用预设的values类别作为低可靠性类别，其他应用场景需自行确定哪些类别可靠性低；个体行为推断还需考虑动态性和上下文依赖性，论文未涉及这些维度。

title: Joint Workflow and Prompt Optimization for User Behavior Simulation
comment: under review for ACM Transactions on Information Systems Journal, 34 pages, 2 figures
summary: User behavior simulation is the computational modeling of user interactions within information systems through the use of simulated agents in place of live users. It supports system testing and evaluation, decision-making and forecasting, and user experience design. Existing simulators rely on hand-crafted rules or domain expertise that transfers poorly across tasks. SWORD (Simulation-driven Workflow and Prompt Optimization with Role-based Design) is introduced as a framework that jointly optimizes multi-agent workflow topology and natural-language prompts. It is guided solely by a scalar task metric, without domain initialization or task-specific engineering. The experimental results demonstrate that SWORD achieves statistically significant gains over prompt-only, workflow-only, and staged-optimization baselines under a controlled, identical-backbone comparison. Against the strongest published domain-specific baseline, SWORD further improves accuracy while using a smaller backbone model, substantially less training data, and a very reasonable API cost (\$4--\$6 for each dataset). Beyond predictive performance, SWORD autonomously discovers domain-relevant signals, review-sentiment mapping rules and epidemiological decay priors, purely from scalar error feedback, establishing textual gradients as a mechanism for unsupervised feature-importance discovery in user behavior modeling.

sections.研究问题: SWORD研究多智能体工作流与提示词的联合优化是否优于各单项优化，用于用户行为模拟任务[s71]。Agent Society任务（评论评分预测）属于individual方向，模拟信息系统中用户评分行为以支持系统评估[s2]。核心目标是通过联合闭环优化降低领域专家依赖，而非研究个体行为机制本身[s6]。
sections.核心 insight: 论文发现三个核心现象：(1)工作流-提示非平稳性导致分阶段优化产生次优结果——当工作流改变时，同一角色收到的梯度方向语义不兼容[s9]；(2)文本梯度机制可从标量误差信号中自主识别任务相关特征：在Agent Society中72%梯度与情感相关，在Mask Adoption中发现流行病衰减规则[s125, s186]；(3)联合演化优于单一组件优化，2-5次迭代收敛[s103]。这些发现描述SWORD内部机制，未声明可作为通用行为研究方法[s173]。
sections.方法机制: 三层LLM调用循环实现提示优化：(1)属性反馈——将全局评估归因到特定智能体[s208]；(2)计算梯度——生成自然语言梯度方向；(3)应用梯度——重写提示词。五种搜索空间约简：(1)固定8任务无关角色词表（Analyzer、Planner、Generator等）[s61]；(2)DAG约束（2-8智能体、单源单汇、无环）[s62]；(3)精英选择保留top-E个拓扑[s63]；(4)历史条件proposer[s64]；(5)梯度迹选择从最大误差样本计算[s65]。
sections.实验与结果: 控制GPT-4o-mini backbone下，SWORD显著优于基线。Agent Society：相比Staged ΔMAE=0.253（p=0.0093，d=1.04），相比Workflow-Only ΔMAE=0.199（d=1.04）[s113]。Mask Adoption：相比Staged ΔRMSE=0.158（p=0.0165，d=0.93）[s114]。相比SOCIA-∇：RMSE降低90%，MAE降低52%，标准差低40倍[s100]。学习曲线：早期角色重构梯度占34%，后期转向校准调整（<5%）[s182]。
sections.局限: 论文报告的局限：(1)K=4和E=2是经验选择，未系统性超参扫描[s91]；(2)仅用GPT-4o-mini验证，未测试更大模型[s109]；(3)SOCIA-∇比较仅有单次运行[s238]；(4)种子特定提示词偏差低估高置信度正面评论；(5)仅两个benchmark任务验证。

sections.可借鉴方式: 文本梯度机制可尝试用于从个体交互数据中无监督发现偏好特征——需满足条件：多智能体任务、可量化评估指标、接受8角色结构约束[s61, s65, s208]。8角色词表可作为多智能体模拟系统的角色设计起点，但需验证其对目标行为模拟任务的适用性[s61]。联合优化框架可替代分阶段优化用于其他行为模拟任务——有统计验证支持[s113, s114]。以上均为条件性借鉴，未在目标研究任务上验证。

title: Self-Referenced Social Preferences: Cooperation without Observing Others Rewards
summary: Social preferences can promote cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning, but existing approaches often require agents to observe the rewards of their peers. In many real-world interactions, however, an agent can, as humans do, observe others' behavior and outcomes without access to their private reward signals. We introduce self-referenced social preferences, in which each agent learns a model of its own reward, applies it to other agents' observed transitions to assess their outcomes from its own perspective, and feeds these self-referenced assessments into standard social preferences. We study two ways to incorporate these assessments: modifying the learning reward, or using them to weight policy updates. We evaluate the approach on three sequential social dilemmas, Escape Room, Clean Up, and Commons Harvest, which require volunteering, public-good contribution, and resource restraint, respectively. Across all three environments, agents learn cooperative behavior without observing others' rewards, including in settings where independent learners fail to cooperate, and frequently achieve more equitable divisions of jointly produced returns than agents with access to true rewards. The effective integration point depends on the social preference: inequity aversion works best in the reward together with a value look-ahead, whereas a purely benevolent preference benefits from policy-update weighting. Under partial observability, the policy-update approach continues to support cooperation. These results show that explicit access to other agents' reward signals is not necessary for learning cooperative behavior: social preferences can instead be grounded in self-referenced assessments of others' outcomes derived from their observed behavior.

sections.研究问题: 该研究探索MARL中的技术问题：在智能体无法观察他人私人奖励信号的条件下，如何实现合作行为[s3]。传统社会偏好方法需要访问他人奖励，但研究设定中每个智能体只能访问自身奖励，奖励函数对所有智能体相同，智能体可观察他人环境转换[s8]。这是MARL中合作学习的技术验证问题，对应interaction（代理交互）和group（群体协作）方向，研究技术机制能否支持合作涌现。
sections.核心 insight: 核心发现是自我参照估计足以在三个sequential social dilemmas中支持社会偏好的运作，无需观察他人真实奖励[s86]。具体而言：(1)在Escape Room和Clean Up中，自我参照学习者匹配观察真实奖励的学习者表现，在Commons Harvest中超过plain PPO[s9]；(2)自我参照方法产生更平等的分配——TR-EI中richest agent消耗三分之一苹果而最弱智能体零收益，而SRA-EI在Clean Up中Nash welfare达214（TR-EI仅70）[s97,s196]；(3)不平等厌恶仅与SRR有效（SRR-IA+V在所有游戏中表现最佳），利他偏好与SRA更优（SRA-EI在Escape Room和Commons Harvest更优）[s92]。这是MARL技术效果的验证，非人类社会公平行为的研究证据。
sections.方法机制: 方法机制包含三个技术组件：(1)奖励模型学习：每个智能体i通过回归拟合自身转移的奖励模型fi(o,a,o')，独立于社会项梯度更新，仅使用智能体自身转移数据（最多2048条），采样自独立经验回放池[s43,s129]；(2)两种自我参照注入方式：SRR（自我参照奖励）将估计的他人收益注入奖励函数[s53]；SRA（自我参照优势）将他人视角的估计收益注入策略梯度系数[s57]。两种方式结合不等厌恶（IA）、利他奖励（EI）、社会价值取向（SVO）等社会偏好算子；(3)Standing Ledger：跨episode追踪每个智能体j对智能体i的累计收益估计Gi,j，支持角色轮换[s210]。适用条件为共享奖励函数且智能体可观察他人环境转移[s37,s39]。
sections.实验与结果: 实验在三个sequential social dilemmas中进行，对比四种学习者：plain PPO、TR（观察真实奖励）、SRR和SRA[s76]。主要结果：(1)合作涌现：所有三个游戏中，社会偏好在自我参照评估下可运作，无需观察他人奖励[s86]；(2)公平性差异：自我参照方法产生更平等分配，TR-EI在Commons Harvest产生1530苹果但最弱智能体零收益[s97]；(3)方法-偏好匹配：不等厌恶仅与SRR有效，利他偏好与SRA更优[s92]；(4)部分可观测性：15×15窗口下，SRA保持合作而look-ahead方法失效[s101]；(5)群体扩展：SRA随N增大稀释（1/(N-1)）但仍维持至少三分之二最优产出[s189]。
sections.局限: 主要局限包括：(1)共享奖励函数假设：自我参照仅当所有智能体被相同事件以相同方式奖励时才能恢复他人真实奖励，价值观差异时变为反事实评估[s247,s103]；(2)观察要求：需可观察他人环境转移，不适用完全黑箱交互；(3)计算开销：O(N²)前向传播随智能体数量增加；(4)策略稀释：SRA系数平均所有其他智能体得分，响应任意单个智能体行动的部分随1/(N-1)缩减[s189]；(5)效率权衡：真实奖励学习者产生更高集体收益但分配不均；(6)环境限制：仅在三款sequential social dilemmas测试。
sections.与研究的联系: 该研究是MARL技术验证工作，对应interaction和group方向，研究技术机制能否在无他人奖励观察条件下支持合作[s86]。核心贡献是证明社会偏好可建立在自我参照评估而非直接奖励观察之上[s163]，为去中心化多智能体合作的工程实现提供技术路径。原文将empathy定位为技术手段[s7]，s109提出的'mixed groups of people and machines'是未来方向而非已验证的研究联系。该研究不构成人类社会行为或公平感知演化的证据。
sections.可借鉴方式: 可尝试迁移以下机制：(1)自我参照奖励估计：用于去中心化多智能体场景，在无法观察他人奖励条件下推断他人收益，适用于无通信协商、隐式协调等工程应用；(2)社会偏好注入位置选择：根据偏好类型选择SRR（不平等厌恶等惩罚性偏好）或SRA（利他等增益性偏好）；(3)Standing Ledger追踪：跨episode记录他人收益估计，用于长期博弈中的收益分配分析。迁移条件：需满足共享奖励函数假设、各智能体可观察他人状态转移、智能体具备学习奖励模型的能力。原文未验证该机制用于人类社会行为模拟的可行性。

judgments.reason: 该研究是多智能体强化学习的技术工作，而非社会行为模拟研究。原文s7明确将empathy作为认知机制用于技术实现，s108将方法定位于MARL中的合作学习。虽然研究涉及社会偏好机制和公平分配，但其核心贡献是证明'无需观察他人奖励'这一技术可行性，而非提炼可迁移的社会行为机制。分析员将其定位为'直接服务于多智能体交互中的亲社会行为建模'并评为B级，但B级要求'提供明确服务于研究方向的方法、数据或评测'，而研究档案的interaction/group方向聚焦于'人际/代理交互中的对话、协商、关系、影响与合作'及'多人协作、博弈、群体决策、集体行为'。该论文是MARL中亲社会行为涌现的技术验证，核心问题是'如何让agent合作'而非'理解人类社会行为'，与研究档案目标存在差距。该方法可借鉴迁移到去中心化多智能体合作场景，机制明确（奖励模型自我参照+社会偏好注入+Standing Ledger），条件具体（共享奖励函数、可观察他人转移、智能体具备学习能力），满足C级条件：目标不同但能明确说明迁移机制、目标任务与适用条件。

title: Quantum-Like Spatial Decision Dynamics: A Falsifiable Model of Cue-Order Effects in Immersive Navigation with Implications for Human-Quantum Computer Interaction
comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, and 6 tables. Includes simulation code, synthetic replicate-level results, summary data, and run metadata as ancillary files
summary: The sequence in which a person encounters spatial evidence can change a later choice, yet an order effect alone does not identify a quantum-like cognitive structure. We introduce Quantum-Like Spatial Decision Dynamics (QSDD), a falsifiable state-space account of embodied decision making in which cue exposures are completely positive trace-preserving maps, intermediate judgments are quantum instruments, and route commitment is an operationally defined measurement. We distinguish this formal claim from any assertion that cognition is microscopically quantum. We then specify a minimal binary model with a fixed decision basis, noncommuting cue rotations, a fixed symmetry-breaking initial azimuth, dephasing, and lapse; its five fitted parameters must generalize across environments rather than being refit to individual conditions. A reproducible simulation study evaluates recovery and model discrimination under both QSDD and seven-parameter classical logistic ground truths. Across 40 replicates per design cell, QSDD was preferred on held-out environments in 85% of QSDD-generated datasets at 240 independent observations per environment-order cell and 95% at 480, but in 0% of classically generated datasets at every tested sample size. The simulation also exposes weak identification of the lapse parameter and is explicitly a design analysis, not human evidence. We provide a preregistrable virtual-reality experiment, telemetry schema, classical comparison set, and failure criteria. Finally, we show how the same process-measurement logic can be transferred to human inspection and debugging of quantum circuits. QSDD is therefore offered as a constrained model to be defeated or supported by data, and as a methodologically continuous route from immersive interaction research to human-quantum computer interaction.

sections.研究问题: 研究核心问题是：当个体在沉浸式导航中整合地标（landmark）和地图（allocentric map）信息时，线索暴露的顺序和模式是否以经典模型无法预测的方式改变决策状态[s136]。作者通过引入QSDD（量子样空间决策动力学）回答该问题，将线索暴露建模为量子通道、中介判断为量子仪器、路线承诺为操作性测量事件[s217]。该研究属于individual方向下的个体空间认知决策建模，但成果向人际/群体交互场景的迁移需独立验证。
sections.核心 insight: 核心发现是观察的顺序本身（而非仅内容）通过非交换量子操作改变决策状态[ s217, s223]。作者证明量子概率数学结构可形式化序贯判断的上下文敏感性，无需假设大脑存在微观量子过程[s8]。模拟验证QSDD在QSDD生成数据上可区分于7参数经典逻辑模型（N=480时优选率95%），在经典真值下从未被偏好[s125]。转移机制：非交换性状态更新可用于任何序贯信息整合场景。
sections.方法机制: 模型采用Bloch球表征（二维Hilbert空间），线索暴露对应单位量子比特旋转Uc=exp[−iωc𝒏c⋅𝝈/2]，状态通过非交换旋转演化，去相干乘数κ捕捉量子相干衰减，lapse率ε建模随机错误[s223]。关键约束：5参数必须跨所有环境和线索顺序泛化，而非针对每个条件单独拟合[s106]。该机制区别于经典方法之处在于非交换性（不同顺序的旋转不可交换），导致后验依赖于观察序列。
sections.实验与结果: 双真值模拟研究（QSDD vs 7参数经典逻辑）各40 replicates。QSDD真值下：N=40胜率75%，N=240胜率85%，N=480胜率95%（第5百分位ΔELPD为正）。经典逻辑真值下：所有样本量QSDD胜率均为0%[s125]。参数可恢复性：除lapse外其他参数可恢复，但lapse识别弱（可能需更多观测）。作者明确声明这是设计分析而非人类证据[s125]。

title: MemCo: Memory-Centric Collaboration for Generalizing LLM Agents to Unseen Environments
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in interactive environments, where they need to make sequential decisions through observation, action, and feedback. Although memory can help agents reuse experience, existing work designs memory in isolation, where collecting enough trajectories to populate it is expensive. Existing shared-memory approaches mitigate isolated experience by pooling episodic memories across tasks and environments. However, retrieving shared memory is challenged by the granularity, where retrieved memories can be either too specific to preserve current grounding or too coarse to support the next action. In this work, we propose MemCo, a memory-centric collaboration framework for generalizing LLM agents to unseen interactive environments. It maintains complementary local and global memory spaces, preserving environment-specific details locally while promoting transferable workflows induced from local trajectories to global memory. During online interaction, MemCo routes relevant local and global memories in terms of the agent's current state and decision phase, enabling agents to reuse the experience of other agents without blindly transferring environment-specific details. Experiments on interactive decision-making benchmarks show that MemCo improves task success and reduces redundant exploration compared with isolate-memory and shared-memory baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/SYannL/nvdamas.

title: Jarvis: A Proactive Speech Agent for Multi-Party Conversations
summary: Speech agents are reactive and dyadic: they speak when spoken to, and to one person at a time. We ask what it takes for a speech agent to instead take part in a conversation among several people and speak up only when it can help. We introduce Jarvis, a real-time proactive speech agent that audibly participates in multi-party human conversations. Grounded in a document shared beforehand, Jarvis follows the discussion and intervenes when the group misses or misstates a fact and does not correct itself within a few turns. We make three contributions: a problem setting based on epistemic breakdowns that makes proactive intervention measurable, realized as CHI-180-proactive, a synthetic multi-party dataset seeded with known gaps, errors, and self-corrections; a proactive backbone that harnesses a small, open-weight model with deterministic checks and grounds every claim in a source sentence; and interaction techniques for taking the floor in live speech and showing the cited evidence on screen. On CHI-180-proactive, Jarvis is correct on most events it addresses and stays silent 97% of the time when the group resolves an issue itself. A live study with 23 participants confirms these trends with real-time interventions.

title: HouseholdBench: Evaluating Large Language Models as Predictors of Household Economic Behavior
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to meet a key goal in economics: a quantitative model of household decision making, across a variety of settings. Yet existing evaluations cover few surveys and outcomes, and do not study how households adjust to changing economic conditions. We introduce a new evaluation, HouseholdBench, which unites 6 U.S. household surveys and 32 prediction tasks spanning numeric, categorical and probabilistic outcomes, related to consumption, income, labor, expectations, and housing. Using past behavior, demographics and macroeconomic conditions, the tasks test whether LLMs predict behavior, including how households adjust to changes in various policies. We evaluate 13 proprietary and open-weight LLMs against a no-change baseline and a gradient-boosted tree model. Most LLMs outperform the no-change baseline, including for policy response tasks -- with the best model lowering error for numeric outcomes by 12.2%. Across most tasks, gradient-boosted trees rank first; leading proprietary LLMs approach their performance, but open-weight models lag. LLMs exhibit systematic over- and underprediction across different tasks. We identify methods that enable a 4 billion parameter open-weight model to match proprietary models' performance: fine-tuning and aggregating 16 predictions per observation. Improvements generalize to policy-response tasks, which are excluded from fine-tuning. We release our datasets, code, and leaderboard on our website: https://jn-huang.github.io/householdbench

title: Partially Observable Zero-shot coordination by Predicting Intention of Partner
summary: Zero-shot coordination in embodied settings requires acting while the partner is intermittently out of view, leaving existing methods with ambiguous partner representations and uncertainty over hidden partner states. We propose Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP) to jointly address these challenges. PIP uses a Joint-view VAE to distill richer training-time evidence from the union of both agents' local observations into a partner representation available from local observations alone. Partner-state Belief networks further infer the partner's hidden location and behavioral tendencies from the ego agent's interaction history. We evaluate PIP in Burrito-PO, Overcooked-PO, and a Melting Pot substrate, together with a human evaluation in Burrito-PO. PIP attains the highest mean performance among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. Human evaluation and diagnostic analyses further support coordination with unseen partners and the contributions of both components under partner occlusion.

sections.方法机制: 1) Joint-view VAE蒸馏：从全视角教师VAE蒸馏到局部观察学生VAE，使用KL(qT|qS)方向确保学生覆盖教师的多样性[s77]。2) Partner-state Belief网络：包含Behavioral Belief和Location Belief两个组件，通过预测伙伴行为和位置来补偿视野外信息缺失，各组件有消融实验支持[s75]。训练时使用训练专用的合作伙伴状态目标进行监督，部署时策略仅基于自我观察和自我估计的信念行动[s85]。
sections.实验与结果: PIP在Burrito-PO所有4种布局、Overcooked-PO CounterCircuit和Melting Pot coop_mining均取得最佳性能[s60]。消融实验表明蒸馏VAE、Behavioral Belief和Location Belief各组件互补[s75]。人类评估中参与者获得最高稀疏奖励(476.0 vs GAMMA的355.7)，72.7%参与者首选PIP，各维度评分均显著优于基线（协调+36.1%，可预测性+45.0%，适应性+48.6%）[s196, s204]。观测腐败实验中PIP仍优于GAMMA[r=0.2时稀疏遮蔽207.1，噪声混洗187.8][s188]。
sections.局限: 信念模块训练需要辅助监督（未来伙伴动作和位置标签），在真实分散式设置中可能难以获取，需要弱监督或自监督信念学习方法[s85]。此外，方法设计针对人工AI代理协调，不直接适用于人类社会行为的理解或预测。
sections.与研究的联系: 本文属于人工多智能体系统协调研究，与研究档案中的interaction方向有关但研究对象不同。档案关注真实人际行为建模，本文关注AI代理协调；档案评估社会行为指标，本文评估任务性能。可借鉴的是具体机制设计，而非社会行为发现。
sections.可借鉴方式: 1) BP代理构建方法可尝试迁移用于构建多样化社会模拟伙伴池。原文描述'行为偏好参数化+事件奖励函数'生成多样化伙伴[s88, s89]，迁移条件：需要明确定义行为偏好维度并适用于评估场景而非真实行为预测。2) Behavioral Belief通过预测伙伴行为来补偿视野外信息缺失的设计有消融实验支持[s75]，可作为意图推断机制的参考。3) 联合视角蒸馏训练策略可能适用于多智能体社会模拟中的视角一致性问题，但需进一步验证。

title: STRUCTURALCOST: A controlled reading time dataset for modeling human sentence processing difficulty
summary: We introduce STRUCTURALCOST, a self-paced reading dataset of 475 participants and 40,800 observations isolating the processing cost of long-distance subject-verb dependency resolution. We replicate a low-powered psycholinguistic finding at NLP scale, namely that human reading times at the main verb increase with dependency length, driven by syntactic embedding beyond linear distance. Different language models -- spanning n-gram models, SSMs, and transformers -- partially mirror this graded difficulty profile, yet underestimate the integration cost humans incur, with a gap that persists across architectures and model sizes. This suggests these models capture the predictive component of human processing but not the full integration cost that working memory imposes. STRUCTURALCOST provides data needed to drive progress toward evaluating the cognitive plausibility of language models.

sections.研究问题: 该研究检验语言模型（LMs）的surprisal能否捕捉人类句子处理难度，特别是依赖长度带来的记忆整合成本。核心问题：LMs是否捕获了预测成分之外的记忆整合成本[s2][s5]。研究采用controlled dataset设计，系统操纵句法结构同时保持依存长度跨条件恒定，从而隔离词汇混淆因素[s7]。这与individual方向相关，因为涉及个体认知状态（工作记忆容量、处理难度）的建模与评估。
sections.核心 insight: 人类在主动词处的阅读时间随依存长度增加而上升，且受句法深度驱动而非单纯线性距离；当前LMs（包括n-gram、SSM、transformer）仅部分复制该难度梯度，始终低估人类承受的整合成本[s8]。这表明LMs捕获了预测成分但未捕获工作记忆施加的完整整合成本。个体差异分析还发现surprisal与快速读者的相关性反而最低（r=0.15-0.22），与中慢速读者拟合度更高（r=0.36-0.40），表明高效读者采用绕过surprisal追踪的整合策略[s132]。
sections.方法机制: Controlled dataset设计是核心方法论贡献——保持主语-动词对恒定，系统变化介入材料以操纵依存距离，从而隔离词汇混淆因素[s7]。六种条件：baseline(0词)、PP(4词)、SRC(4词)、ORC(4词)、2×SRC(9词)、2×ORC(9词)[s22]。数据收集采用475名被试的自定步速阅读任务，并进行工作记忆容量测试[s27]。评估方法包含全局对齐（所有词位的surprisal-RT相关）和局部对齐（限制到主动词整合位点），后者是更强认知 plausibility测试[s39]。
sections.实验与结果: 依存长度每增加一个词，阅读时间约增加3ms[s34]。在相同4词依存距离下，PP效应可忽略(d=-0.08)，SRC有小幅效应(d=-0.15)，ORC效应最大(d=-0.19)[s33]。双重嵌入条件反而比单一嵌入更快，存在与预期相反的逆转[s33]。全局surprisal-RT相关性约r=0.51-0.53，但限制到主动词时所有模型相关性显著下降，n-gram模型在Dep=4和Dep=9处完全失效[s56][s135]。模型规模增大无一致改善，甚至最大变体损失相关性[s57]。预测的EOI效应比观察值小1-3个数量级[s60]。
sections.局限: 该数据集仅针对英语；有针对性的诊断工具而非通用基准；未充分探索个体差异与工作记忆容量的关系[s9]。研究发现具有明确的实验控制边界，迁移至其他语言或更复杂语境需额外验证。
sections.与研究的联系: 该研究直接服务于individual方向中个体认知状态（工作记忆、阅读难度）的建模，与个体心理状态和认知资源约束的用户模拟相关[s5][s6]。Controlled manipulation设计可用于研究个体历史/记忆对当前选择的影响，需说明迁移条件[s17]。发现architectural inductive biases影响认知 plausibility，提示记忆机制设计需考虑成本约束[s13]。
sections.可借鉴方式: 1) Controlled manipulation设计原则可尝试迁移：保持目标刺激恒定，系统操纵介入因素以隔离特定认知效应，验证agent是否捕获记忆整合成本而非仅预测成分。2) 个体差异分析方法可借鉴：按处理效率分组（快/中/慢读者），分析模型与不同认知风格个体的对齐程度[s131][s132]。3) 局部对齐评估思路：限制分析到关键决策点而非全序列，以更严格测试认知 plausibility[s39]。适用条件：迁移至社会行为模拟时需验证任务可比性，且仅评估认知资源约束维度，不涵盖社会交互动态。
